title: The Fool
description: A leap of faith into the unknown. The Fool stands at the edge of a cliff with only a small bag and a dog at his heels, ready to begin a journey full of possibility and innocent trust.

title: The Magician
description: Manifestation and resourcefulness. With one hand raised to heaven and one pointing to earth, the Magician shows you already hold every tool needed to turn an idea into reality.

title: The High Priestess
description: Intuition, mystery, and inner knowledge. Seated between the black and white pillars, she guards the secrets that surface when you trust your instincts over what is obvious.

title: The Empress
description: Abundance, fertility, and nurturing creativity. Surrounded by a lush garden and a field of wheat, she is the energy of growth, comfort, and natural plenty.

title: The Emperor
description: Structure, authority, and discipline. Seated on his stone throne, he provides stability and order — the framework that turns chaos into something lasting.

title: The Hierophant
description: Tradition, spiritual guidance, and shared wisdom. He is the bridge between the sacred and the everyday, offering teachings passed down through generations.

title: The Lovers
description: Love, harmony, and a meaningful choice. More than romance, this card speaks of alignment — a decision made with the whole heart.

title: The Chariot
description: Determination, willpower, and victory through focus. Two sphinxes pull in different directions, yet the charioteer keeps them both moving forward.

title: Strength
description: Courage, patience, and gentle mastery over instinct. The woman calmly closes the lion's jaws, showing that true power comes from compassion, not force.

title: The Hermit
description: Solitude, introspection, and inner guidance. With his lantern raised high, he lights the way for anyone willing to look within for answers.

title: Wheel of Fortune
description: Cycles, fate, and turning points. The wheel never stops spinning — what rises must fall — bringing change beyond your control but not beyond your understanding.

title: Justice
description: Fairness, truth, and consequence. With her scales and her sword, she reminds you that every choice carries a weight and every action has an answer.

title: The Hanged Man
description: Surrender, new perspective, and letting go. Suspended upside down, he sees the world differently — sometimes you must pause in order to gain clarity.

title: Death
description: Transformation, endings, and rebirth. Not a literal death, but the necessary ending that clears the ground for something new to begin.

title: Temperance
description: Balance, moderation, and patient blending. The angel pours water between two cups, showing that harmony comes from mixing opposites in the right measure.

title: The Devil
description: Bondage, materialism, and the shadow self. Chained to the pedestal, the figures could leave at any moment — the card asks what truly holds you back.

title: The Tower
description: Sudden upheaval and revelation. Struck by lightning, the tower crumbles — false structures fall away and truth remains in the ashes.

title: The Star
description: Hope, inspiration, and healing. Kneeling by the water, the figure pours life back into the world — a gentle promise that renewal follows hardship.

title: The Moon
description: Illusion, fear, and the subconscious. The moon lights the path but distorts it — not everything in the dark is what it seems; trust your intuition.

title: The Sun
description: Joy, success, and vitality. The sun shines over a walled garden where a child rides a white horse — pure, uncomplicated happiness.

title: Judgement
description: Rebirth, inner calling, and absolution. The angel's trumpet wakes the figures from their graves — a call to rise, answer, and begin again.

title: The World
description: Completion, integration, and wholeness. Dancing inside a laurel wreath, the figure has finished the great journey — achievement and the close of a cycle.

title: Ace of Wands
description: A spark of inspiration and raw creative potential. A hand emerges from the clouds holding a sprouting wand — the seed of a bold new venture.

title: Two of Wands
description: Planning, decision, and looking toward the horizon. Standing on a castle battlement with a globe in hand, you weigh the world — the choice of where to go next is yours.

title: Three of Wands
description: Expansion, foresight, and early success. Ships sail on the horizon while the merchant watches from the shore — your groundwork is beginning to pay off.

title: Four of Wands
description: Celebration, harmony, and a milestone reached. A garlanded pavilion marks a happy occasion — homecoming, reunion, or a well-earned rest.

title: Five of Wands
description: Conflict, competition, and clashing egos. Five figures swing their wands in a mock battle — disagreement tests you, but it need not defeat you.

title: Six of Wands
description: Victory, recognition, and public success. Carried on shoulders through cheering crowds, the rider shows that effort is seen and rewarded.

title: Seven of Wands
description: Defense, perseverance, and protecting your ground. From the hilltop you fend off attackers from above — you hold the advantage, so stand firm.

title: Eight of Wands
description: Speed, swift action, and rapid movement. Eight wands fly through the air like arrows — a message, project, or change arriving faster than expected.

title: Nine of Wands
description: Resilience, grit, and the last stand. Wounded but watchful, you lean on your wand — tired, perhaps, but nearly there. Keep going.

title: Ten of Wands
description: Burden, responsibility, and overwhelm. Carrying all ten wands at once, you struggle forward — success can become a weight when you carry it alone.

title: Page of Wands
description: Curiosity, exploration, and a burst of creative energy. The page gazes at his wand like a messenger bearing exciting news — a new passion to pursue.

title: Knight of Wands
description: Impulsiveness, adventure, and charging ahead. The knight rides off in search of quests — bold, passionate action, sometimes without a plan.

title: Queen of Wands
description: Confidence, warmth, and independent determination. Seated with her wand, she is fire made steady — a charismatic presence who inspires everyone around her.

title: King of Wands
description: Vision, leadership, and mastery of fire. The king holds his wand like a scepter — bold ideas executed with the authority of hard-won experience.

title: Ace of Cups
description: An overflowing cup of new love, joy, and emotional beginnings. A hand from the clouds offers a vessel brimming with feeling — a fresh start of the heart.

title: Two of Cups
description: Partnership, mutual attraction, and union. Two figures exchange cups face to face — a meaningful connection built on equality and affection.

title: Three of Cups
description: Friendship, community, and shared celebration. Three women raise their cups in a joyful gathering — togetherness and collective happiness.

title: Four of Cups
description: Apathy, contemplation, and a missed opportunity. Seated under a tree, the figure ignores the cup offered from a cloud — sometimes you must look up to see what is being given.

title: Five of Cups
description: Loss, grief, and dwelling on what is gone. Kneeling before three spilled cups, the figure mourns — but two cups still stand behind him. Not all is lost.

title: Six of Cups
description: Nostalgia, childhood memory, and innocent joy. Children fill their cups in a garden — a return to simpler times and pure, uncomplicated happiness.

title: Seven of Cups
description: Choices, fantasy, and wishful thinking. Seven cups drift in the clouds, each holding a vision — dreams are abundant, but only one can become real.

title: Eight of Cups
description: Walking away, deeper meaning, and leaving the familiar. The figure departs at night with six cups behind — sometimes growth means leaving what is comfortable.

title: Nine of Cups
description: Contentment, satisfaction, and a wish fulfilled. Arms crossed before nine full cups, the figure savours the quiet joy of having enough.

title: Ten of Cups
description: Lasting harmony, love, and emotional fulfillment. A rainbow arcs over a family dancing together — deep belonging and a happy home.

title: Page of Cups
description: Creativity, intuition, and a gentle new message. The page gazes at the fish in his cup — a sensitive soul receiving emotional or artistic inspiration.

title: Knight of Cups
description: Romance, charm, and following the heart. The knight rides a white horse bearing a cup — an offer of love, or a creative pursuit chased with idealism.

title: Queen of Cups
description: Compassion, emotional maturity, and deep intuition. Seated by the sea with her cup, she is a nurturing, empathic presence who feels more than she says.

title: King of Cups
description: Emotional balance, diplomacy, and mastery of feelings. Ruling the waves from his throne, he is calm control over deep waters — generous, wise, and kind.

title: Ace of Swords
description: A breakthrough of clarity and a piercing new idea. The hand from the clouds raises a sword crowned with laurels — the triumph of the mind.

title: Two of Swords
description: Indecision, difficult choices, and stalemate. Blindfolded and balancing two crossed blades, the figure shows that the hardest choice is often the one you avoid.

title: Three of Swords
description: Heartbreak, sorrow, and painful truth. A storm rages over a heart pierced by three swords — grief that is real, but not forever.

title: Four of Swords
description: Rest, recovery, and quiet contemplation. The figure lies in peaceful repose — a necessary pause that restores your strength.

title: Five of Swords
description: Conflict, hollow victory, and winning at a cost. The victor gathers swords while others retreat — a win that can leave you poorer than before.

title: Six of Swords
description: Transition, moving on, and leaving turmoil behind. A ferryman carries passengers toward calm waters — a journey toward healing and a gentler shore.

title: Seven of Swords
description: Strategy, deception, and slipping away. The figure creeps off with five swords, leaving two behind — sometimes you must act quietly to get what you need.

title: Eight of Swords
description: Restriction, negative thoughts, and feeling trapped. Bound and blindfolded before eight swords, the figure reminds you that the cage is often one you build yourself.

title: Nine of Swords
description: Anxiety, worry, and sleepless nights. Sitting up in bed with nine swords on the wall, the figure shows how fear looms largest in the dark.

title: Ten of Swords
description: Painful endings, deep wounds, and rock bottom. Pierced by ten swords at dawn — the darkest moment right before the light returns.

title: Page of Swords
description: Vigilance, curiosity, and a sharp new idea. The page raises his sword — an eager mind hunting for truth and fresh perspectives.

title: Knight of Swords
description: Ambition, action, and charging into battle. The knight gallops with his sword raised — swift and decisive, and sometimes reckless.

title: Queen of Swords
description: Independence, clear boundaries, and honest intellect. Seated among the clouds with her sword, she is uncompromising truth — perceptive, fair, and direct.

title: King of Swords
description: Authority, truth, and intellectual power. The king lifts his sword to the sky — reason and justice wielded with a steady, incorruptible hand.

title: Ace of Pentacles
description: A new financial opportunity and a material beginning. The hand from the cloud offers a golden pentacle — prosperity and security taking root.

title: Two of Pentacles
description: Balance, adaptability, and juggling priorities. The figure dances with two pentacles linked by an infinity ribbon — keeping many things in motion at once.

title: Three of Pentacles
description: Teamwork, craftsmanship, and collaboration. The mason carves a cathedral arch while his client looks on — skill recognized and rewarded through cooperation.

title: Four of Pentacles
description: Security, control, and holding on tightly. Pentacles clutched to crown, hands, and feet give stability — but at the cost of openness.

title: Five of Pentacles
description: Hardship, loss, and feeling left out in the cold. Two figures pass a lit window in the snow — struggle is real, but shelter and help exist if you ask for them.

title: Six of Pentacles
description: Generosity, giving, and fair exchange. The merchant weighs coins on his scales, giving to those in need — charity and balanced reciprocity.

title: Seven of Pentacles
description: Patience, long-term view, and assessing progress. The farmer leans on his staff, surveying vines heavy with fruit — hard work is growing, but the harvest is not yet in.

title: Eight of Pentacles
description: Apprenticeship, skill, and diligent practice. The artisan carves pentacles one by one — mastery comes from focused, repeated effort.

title: Nine of Pentacles
description: Luxury, self-sufficiency, and enjoying the fruits of labor. The woman walks her vineyard with a hooded falcon — independence and refined comfort.

title: Ten of Pentacles
description: Wealth, inheritance, and lasting legacy. A family beneath an archway of pentacles — prosperity shared across generations.

title: Page of Pentacles
description: Ambition, practicality, and a new opportunity. The page studies his pentacle — a grounded approach to manifesting material goals.

title: Knight of Pentacles
description: Hard work, routine, and dependable progress. The knight rides slowly across fertile fields — steady, methodical effort that reliably gets results.

title: Queen of Pentacles
description: Nurturing, practicality, and abundant comfort. Seated in her lush garden, she is a generous provider of material and emotional security.

title: King of Pentacles
description: Success, abundance, and material mastery. The king on his throne, the bull's head on his pedestal — wealth and business acumen at their peak.
